title: Workspace backend-binding concurrency guards
description: Locks visible matching Project rows in UUID order without waiting, then clears only those locked IDs in the caller transaction. Busy bindings abort the statement and caller transaction; no partial registry deletion can commit. Backend enablement rechecks the selected registry membership after taking its Pool lock and rejects a missing Pool or stale membership selection before writes.

pool_id.description: Non-null pool UUID supplied by the registry-deletion caller.

ClearPrimaryBackendBindingsReply.description: Number of Project rows updated by the fixed command.

binding_busy.message: Workspace primary backend bindings are busy

backend_selection_changed.message: Workspace backend selection changed while waiting for its pool
